Definition: Does the government maintain a digital address register?
Comments: National Addressing System approved (S42 standard), implementation ongoing with legal framework development. Street naming in progress (e.g. Beau Vallon). Planned.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Cabinet approved the Seychelles National Addressing System Bill 2026 (reported April 2026), establishing a National Addressing Department and Database Unit and adopting international addressing/postcode standards; Seychelles Nation (Nov 2025) reports the project has gained strong momentum with completion targeted for end-2026. This is beyond mere planning (draft legal framework and implementing bodies now exist), so revised from Planned (2) to Under development (3).

Comments: Business registration requires company cert from Registrar, TIN links to business reg no.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed — the Seychelles Revenue Commission's TIN/SBN registration portal captures and validates the Business Registration Number issued by the Registrar of Companies in real time (an invalid BRN is flagged), and SRC registration additionally requires a copy of the Registrar's company certificate. This indicates a field-level/document-based link rather than full automated data exchange, consistent with Partially integrated (code 4 unchanged).
